name: runAllTests
example: runAllTests            % 169 tests; acceptance gate on R2026a

name: setup_shAnalysis
example:
setup_shAnalysis(Permanent = true, Download = "core")
    setup_shAnalysis(Download = "filters", DDK = [2 3 5])
    s = setup_shAnalysis(DryRun = true, Download = "starter")

name: shClimatology.amplitudeMap
example: [A, lat, lon] = clim.amplitudeMap("annual", -89:89, 0:359, quantity = "ewh", kn = kn);

name: shClimatology.eval
example: g2020 = clim.eval(2020.0);             % model field at an epoch

name: shCoefficients.addDegree1
example: g = g.addDegree1(tn13);               % nearest epoch within 0.05 yr

name: shCoefficients.deformation
example:
[up, no, ea] = g.deformation(latPts, lonPts, kn = LN.kn, hn = LN.hn, ...
    ln = LN.ln, Mode = "points");

name: shCoefficients.degreeRMS
example: spec = g.degreeRMS();                  % degree amplitude + error spectrum

name: shCoefficients.evalAt
example: g2015 = g.evalAt(2015.5);              % gfct variable terms AT AN EPOCH

name: shCoefficients.fromVec
example: g2 = shCoefficients.fromVec(x, idx, g10);   % sizes/GM/R from template

name: shCoefficients.minus
example: dg = g - gMean;                       % anomaly about the mean field

name: shCoefficients.mtimes
example: gHalf = 0.5 * g;                      % scalar scaling, sigmas follow

name: shCoefficients.setCoefficient
example: g = g.setCoefficient(2, 0, c20slr);   % SLR C20 by hand

name: shLowLevel.applyDDK
example:
W = shLowLevel.readDDK("DDK3", Nmax = 60);
[Cf, Sf] = shLowLevel.applyDDK(g.C, g.S, W);

name: shLowLevel.basinDeconvolve
example:
[avg, out] = shLowLevel.basinDeconvolve(B, op);   % op from ts.filter("tvANS")
errorbar(op.tYears, avg(1,:), out.sigma(1,:))

name: shLowLevel.basinScaling
example: k = shLowLevel.basinScaling(op, b, tsHydModel);   % scale factor vs a model series

name: shLowLevel.buildNoiseCov
example: N = shLowLevel.buildNoiseCov(Xres, idx);          % empirical order/parity blocks

name: shLowLevel.compareSeries
shLowLevel.compareSolutions
shLowLevel.csFromVec
example: [C, S] = shLowLevel.csFromVec(x, idx);           % vector -> triangle matrices

name: shLowLevel.ddkNames
example: names = shLowLevel.ddkNames();               % Wbd file names DDK1..8

name: shLowLevel.designFilter
example:
W = shLowLevel.designFilter(g.sigmaC, g.sigmaS, Alpha = 1);
    gF = g.applyDDK(W);                % apply like any DDK

name: shLowLevel.diffSpectrum
shLowLevel.effectiveCorr
example:
ec = shLowLevel.effectiveCorr(avg(1,:)', avg(2,:)');   % two basin series
    fprintf("r = %.3f (p = %.3g, Neff = %.0f)\n", ec.r, ec.p, ec.neff)

name: shLowLevel.eofAnalysis
example:
[modes, pcs, ve] = shLowLevel.eofAnalysis(resid);
plot(resid.epochs, pcs(:, 1))         % leading principal component

name: shLowLevel.errorMap
example: sig = shLowLevel.errorMap(M, idx, -89:4:89, 0:4:356, quantity = "ewh", kn = kn);

name: shLowLevel.fetchICGEM
example: f = shLowLevel.fetchICGEM("GOCO06s");        % static model by name

name: shLowLevel.fetchLoveNumbers
example:
[f, inf] = shLowLevel.fetchLoveNumbers();
    kn = inf.parsed(1).kn(1:61);        % degrees 0..60 for an n60 field

name: shLowLevel.fetchTN
shLowLevel.fitDeterministicModel
example: [model, Xres, coef, A, sig] = shLowLevel.fitDeterministicModel(X, tYears, ARCorrect = true);

name: shLowLevel.gridScaling
example:
k = shLowLevel.gridScaling(modelEWH, -89:89, 0:359, Filter = "gauss300");
corrected = k .* filteredEWH;      % NaN where the model is blind

name: shLowLevel.kernelFactors
example: kf = shLowLevel.kernelFactors("ewh", 60, GM, R, kn = kn);

name: shLowLevel.leakageCorrect
shLowLevel.legendreALF
example: P = shLowLevel.legendreALF(96, deg2rad(-89:89));   % stable to n=2190

name: shLowLevel.listITSG
example:
T = shLowLevel.listITSG();
    disp(T)     % pick rows, then fetch via Catalog= in fetchITSG

name: shLowLevel.mcPropagate
example: out = shLowLevel.mcPropagate(@(gs) gs.C(3, 1), g, N = 200);   % any functional of g

name: shLowLevel.nashSutcliffe
example: nse = shLowLevel.nashSutcliffe(avg(1,:), avg(2,:));   % e.g. SH vs mascon basin

name: shLowLevel.opApply
example: xf = shLowLevel.opApply(op, op.Xres(:, 1), 1);   % W_1 * x without the P x P matrix

name: shLowLevel.plotSHCoeffTriangle
example:
shLowLevel.plotSHCoeffTriangle(g.C, g.S);
shLowLevel.plotSHCoeffTriangle(gF.C, gF.S, RefC = g.C, RefS = g.S);   % signed diff

name: shLowLevel.plotSHSpectrum
example:
spec = shLowLevel.shDegreeRMS(g.C, g.S);
shLowLevel.plotSHSpectrum(spec, Kaula = true, MarkCrossover = true);

name: shLowLevel.poleTideConvert
example:
g18 = shLowLevel.poleTideConvert(g, From = "IERS2010", To = "IERS2018");
    dC21 = g18.C(3, 2) - g.C(3, 2)     % ~1e-10 level, trend-like in t

name: shLowLevel.readDDK
example: W = shLowLevel.readDDK("DDK3");   % DDK3 ships with the toolbox; others via shLowLevel.fetchDDK

name: shLowLevel.readLoveNumbers
shLowLevel.readSHM
example:
gia = shLowLevel.readSHM("GRAVIS-2B_..._GIA_ICE-6G_D_VM5a.gz", Nmax = 96);
g   = shCoefficients(gia.C, gia.S, GM = gia.GM, R = gia.R);   % rates [1/yr]

name: shLowLevel.readSINEX
example:
snx = shLowLevel.readSINEX("ITSG-Grace2018_n96_2008-04_head12.snx");
fprintf("%s with %d params\n", snx.kind, numel(snx.x))

name: shLowLevel.rescaleGMR
example: [C2, S2] = shLowLevel.rescaleGMR(g.C, g.S, g.GM, g.R, GMref, Rref);

name: shLowLevel.safeMove
example:
shLowLevel.shReadGFC(tmpf);                 % verify BEFORE the swap
shLowLevel.safeMove(tmpf, "ITSG-Grace2018_n60_2008-04.gfc");

name: shLowLevel.seaLevelFingerprint
example: S = shLowLevel.seaLevelFingerprint(gLoad, oceanMask, idx, kn = LN.kn, hn = LN.hn);

name: shLowLevel.shAnalysisGrid
example: g2 = shLowLevel.shAnalysisGrid(grid, lat, lon, 10);   % exact on ring grids

name: shLowLevel.shDegreeRMS
example: spec = shLowLevel.shDegreeRMS(g.C, g.S);          % degree-amplitude spectrum struct

name: shLowLevel.shEvalGFCT
example: [C, S] = shLowLevel.shEvalGFCT(model, 2015.5);   % piecewise gfct at an epoch

name: shLowLevel.shOrderRMS
example: spec = shLowLevel.shOrderRMS(g.C, g.S);           % stripes live at high orders

name: shLowLevel.shSpectralCrossover
example:
spec = shLowLevel.shDegreeRMS(g.C, g.S, 'sigmaC', g.sigmaC, 'sigmaS', g.sigmaS);
nc = shLowLevel.shSpectralCrossover(spec);   % signal/error crossover degree

name: shLowLevel.shSynthesisDeformation
example: [up, no, ea] = shLowLevel.shSynthesisDeformation(g.C, g.S, g.R, latPts, lonPts, kn = LN.kn, hn = LN.hn, ln = LN.ln, Mode = "points");

name: shLowLevel.shSynthesisGradientTensor
example: T = shLowLevel.shSynthesisGradientTensor(g.C, g.S, g.GM, g.R, lat, lon, Height = 450e3);

name: shLowLevel.spatialStats
shLowLevel.synthesisPoints
example:
dg = shLowLevel.synthesisPoints(g.C, g.S, g.GM, g.R, ...
        [10; 12], [100; 101], (g.R + 450e3) * [1; 1], ...
        Quantity = "disturbance") * 1e5;   % mGal at 450 km

name: shLowLevel.taylorDiagram
example:
st = shLowLevel.spatialStats(grid, 0.8 * grid, lat, lon);
    shLowLevel.taylorDiagram(st.stdA, st.stdB, st.corr, Labels = "damped");

name: shLowLevel.threeCorneredHat
example:
out = shLowLevel.threeCorneredHat(Y3);   % T x 3 basin series (CSR/GFZ/JPL)
    fprintf("noise levels: %s\n", sprintf("%.3g ", out.sigma))

name: shLowLevel.tvANSFilter
example:
[Xf, op, info] = shLowLevel.tvANSFilter(X, tYears, idx);
sigma = info.sigmaXfres;              % exact posterior (v2.5 incl. constraints)

name: shLowLevel.vceRescale
example: s = shLowLevel.vceRescale(N, Xres, idx);          % monthly noise factors

name: shLowLevel.vecFromCS
example: x = shLowLevel.vecFromCS(g10.C, g10.S, idx);     % triangle -> idx-ordered vector

name: shLowLevel.version
example:
v = shLowLevel.version();
    fprintf("%s %s (%s)\n", v.Name, v.Version, v.Date)

name: shLowLevel.writeAnimation
example: shLowLevel.writeAnimation(ts, "ewh_2019_2022.avi", quantity = "ewh", kn = kn);   % .avi portable, .mp4 on Windows/macOS

name: shLowLevel.writeGFC
example: shLowLevel.writeGFC("out.gfc", g.C, g.S, g.GM, g.R, Comment = "DDK3 filtered");

name: shLowLevel.ylm
example: Y = shLowLevel.ylm(deg2rad(latPts), deg2rad(lonPts), idx);   % design rows, idx order

name: shSeries.at
example: g = ts.at(37);                         % single month as shCoefficients

name: shSeries.basinAverage
example: [avg, out] = tsF.basinAverage(B, Deconvolve = true, Op = op);

name: shSeries.filter
example: [tsF, op, info] = ts.filter("tvANS", Constraints = Ac, Blocks = "off");

name: shSeries.removeGIA
example: ts = ts.removeGIA(giaModel);           % e.g. ICE-6G trend gfc

name: shSeries.shSeries
example: ts = shSeries(Cs, Ss = Ss, Epochs = tYears);

name: shSeries.trendBreaks
example: out = ts.trendBreaks(Breaks = 2021.0); % F-test on the hinge
